metadata.name: MTA Bus Stops
metadata.description: This dataset contains point features for bus stops used on each route and direction within a bundle, including stop usage flags (revenue, timepoint, boarding, alighting, is in CBD) and basic route descriptors for mapping and stop-level analyses.

columns.name: Valid From
columns.description: First service_date (inclusive) for which this shape is valid within the bundle, in MM/DD/YYYY.

columns.name: Valid To
columns.description: Last service_date (inclusive) for which this shape is valid within the bundle, in MM/DD/YYYY.

columns.name: In Effect
columns.description: A true / false flag of whether the stop is currently in effect.

columns.name: Route ID
columns.description: The ID of the bus route that uses the timepoint.

columns.name: Route Short Name
columns.description: The short name for the bus route. This is identical to Route ID except for Select Bus Service routes, which are shown with a suffix of a + in Route ID but have a suffix of SBS here, or for some shuttle bus routes.

columns.name: Route Long Name
columns.description: The long name for the bus route, including the neighborhoods or streets the bus runs between or runs along.

columns.name: Route Description
columns.description: A more detailed description of the bus route indicating the main streets it traverses. This field can be NULL.

columns.name: Route Color
columns.description: The six-digit Hex Color code that matches public facing material for the bus route.

columns.name: Stop ID
columns.description: The six-digit stop ID given by NYC DOT to identify each bus stop (one for each "lollipop" sign).

columns.name: Stop Name
columns.description: The name of the bus stop, typically consisting of the street the bus is stopping on, followed by the nearest cross-street. This value is blank for non-revenue stops.

columns.name: Direction ID
columns.description: Direction code; 0 for Northbound/Eastbound, 1 for Southbound/Westbound.

columns.name: Direction
columns.description: Cardinal direction letter (N, S, E, W) corresponding to direction_id.

columns.name: Revenue Stop
columns.description: Flag indicating whether the stop is revenue-serving stop (0 or 1).

columns.name: Timepoint
columns.description: Flag indicating whether the stop is a timepoint in schedules (0 or 1).

columns.name: Boarding
columns.description: Flag indicating whether boarding is allowed at this stop (0 or 1).

columns.name: Alighting
columns.description: Flag indicating whether alighting is allowed at this stop (0 or 1).

columns.name: Is CBD
columns.description: Flag indicating whether the stop lies within the Central Business District (CBD); true or false.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: The latitude of the timepoint.

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: The longitude of the timepoint

columns.name: Bundle
columns.description: Identifier of the schedule bundle release (GTFS/STIF package).

columns.name: Georeference
columns.description: Open Data platform-generated geocoding information from supplied address components. Point-type location is the centroid of the address components provided and does not reflect a specific address if the street address component is not provided. Point-type location is supplied in "POINT ( )" format.

columns.name: New York Zip Codes
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'New York Zip Codes' (wbg7-3whc) the point in column 'georeference' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

columns.name: Counties
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Counties' (kjdx-g34t) the point in column 'georeference' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

columns.name: NYS Municipal Boundaries
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'NYS Municipal Boundaries' (yamh-8v7k) the point in column 'georeference' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

Dataset Summary.Granularity: Each row is a unique stop instance on a route and direction for a specific bundle (route_id, direction_id, stop_id, bundle).
